info.name: Londa Rides API - Complete Collection
info.description:
Complete API collection for Londa Rides CC with all endpoints, proper authentication, and request bodies.

## Authentication:
- Bearer Token authentication is configured at collection level
- Public endpoints (registration, OTP) have auth disabled
- Protected endpoints use {{auth_token}} variable
- Note: accessToken from /verify-otp is a Firebase Custom Token
- In development mode, custom tokens can be used directly
- In production, exchange custom token for ID token using Firebase SDK

## Getting Started:
1. Register/Login to get auth_token (custom token)
2. Token is auto-saved to collection variable
3. All protected endpoints will use the token automatically
4. For mobile apps, see Frontend Integration Guide for token exchange

## Important Notes:
- user_id and driver_id are automatically extracted from auth tokens
- Do NOT include user_id or driver_id in request bodies
- See API_DOCUMENTATION.md for complete endpoint details
- See FRONTEND_INTEGRATION_GUIDE.md for mobile app integration
